name: @celestia/pictor
description: Pictor — the Painter's Easel: the framework-agnostic client RENDER ORCHESTRATOR. Projects the Jupiter World's entity store onto a RenderBackend, owning all the shared logic (id-diff, follow-camera, HUD, facing/animation selection, the per-entity VisualSpec). A renderer differs ONLY in its draw primitives (PixiBackend, PhaserBackend, a Godot GDScript backend later), never in the orchestration.
